name: QuestDB
label: QuestDB REST — /exec and /imp
description: Official QuestDB REST. GET /exec?query= and POST /imp. Default http://localhost:9000; edit api_spec.baseUrl for Cloud (engine cannot bind host). Handler: OfficialApiNode. HTTP Basic user+password (documented for OSS when enabled and for Cloud). import.csv POSTs multipart/form-data field data (CSV) as /imp requires (https://questdb.com/docs/query/rest-api/). password is never logged or returned. Customer owns the instance.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. execute.sql requires query. import.csv requires data (CSV) plus optional name, timestamp, partitionBy, overwrite (query params). Do not put password here. Example: {"operation":"execute.sql","query":"SELECT 1"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: 'execute.sql' | 'import.csv'.

schema.label: query
schema.description: SQL for execute.sql GET /exec?query=. Example: SELECT * FROM sensors LIMIT 10.

schema.label: name
schema.description: import.csv table name query param. Defaults to the uploaded filename. Example: sensors.

schema.label: timestamp
schema.description: import.csv designated timestamp column name. Example: ts.

schema.label: partitionBy
schema.description: import.csv partition. EXACT: NONE | HOUR | DAY | WEEK | MONTH | YEAR. Default NONE (DAY if timestamp is set). Example: DAY.

schema.label: overwrite
schema.description: import.csv. true drops and recreates the table. Default false.

schema.label: data
schema.description: import.csv official multipart part name data (curl -F data=@file.csv). CSV/TAB/pipe text, a platform file ContentBlock {mime_type, source, data, name}, or a file list. Example: ts,temp\n2026-01-01T00:00:00.000000Z,21.5

schema.label: atomicity
schema.description: import.csv error mode. EXACT: abort | skipRow | skipCol. Default skipCol. Example: skipRow.

schema.label: delimiter
schema.description: import.csv delimiter when auto-detect is not enough. URL-encoded char. Example: , or %3B.

schema.label: fmt
schema.description: import.csv response format. EXACT: tabular | json. Example: json.

schema.label: forceHeader
schema.description: import.csv. true treats the first line as the header. Default false.

schema.label: skipLev
schema.description: import.csv. true ignores rows with extra columns. Default false.

schema.label: o3MaxLag
schema.description: import.csv out-of-order lag for the created table. Example: 10s.

schema.label: maxUncommittedRows
schema.description: import.csv max uncommitted rows before commit. Example: 10000.

schema.label: schema
schema.description: import.csv optional multipart schema part: JSON array of {name, type, pattern}. Example: [{"name":"ts","type":"TIMESTAMP"}].

schema.label: limit
schema.description: execute.sql /exec row cap. Example: 1000.

schema.label: nm
schema.description: execute.sql. true skips metadata in the JSON response.

schema.label: count
schema.description: execute.sql. true includes a count field.

schema.label: timings
schema.description: execute.sql. true includes server timings.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (dataset JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON (columns, dataset, count, timings).

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: execute.sql | import.csv.

configurationParameters.label: User
configurationParameters.description: HTTP Basic username. Required by the handler. If OSS has auth disabled, still set a non-empty user; the server typically ignores Authorization.

configurationParameters.label: Password
configurationParameters.description: HTTP Basic password (StudioQuack secret). Never log or place on INPUT. Must be non-empty. Cloud: real password. OSS with auth off: placeholder so the handler can send Basic.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
